Name: Larvuks Remixed Mine Rewards
Author: Larvuk
Description:
Replace Vanilla mine chest rewards with more diverse and interesting stuff. Will replace vanilla "remixed mine rewards" as well.

Not supposed to unbalance the game, but could sometimes bring one or two late game items in early months. This is more designed to add variation of gameplay and replay value on early game.

You'll still get only one reward per treasure floor.

Uses Mine Treasure Framework. [b]Does not[/b] need to set MineTreasureFramework's [i]EnableFloorTypeChange[/i] to true.

----------------------------------------------
